verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a remote-access and IT-management client like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting or policy to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The community items about font detection, stored credentials and session flagging do not describe an opt-out capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
